failed_invocation.stage: lifecycle reconstruction before report, exposure, daily mapping, drawdown or benchmark evaluation

root_cause: The first implementation treated every executed-position birth as an OPEN event. The immutable event contract emits market births as OPEN, but the Passive component emits PASSIVE_PLACE followed by either PASSIVE_FILL or PASSIVE_EXPIRE; its executed lifecycle begins only at PASSIVE_FILL.

immutable_event_evidence.place_fields: PASSIVE_PLACE value_a is limit price; detail carries direction, stop and planned_risk
immutable_event_evidence.fill_fields: PASSIVE_FILL value_a is actual fill price and value_b is filled volume

corrected_implementation_contract.market_birth: For the five market components, OPEN remains the executed-position birth and all original field rules are unchanged.
corrected_implementation_contract.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE opens one component-local pending record containing declared direction, stop and planned risk. It does not create exposure or occupancy.
corrected_implementation_contract.passive_fill: PASSIVE_FILL must match the single pending record, clears it, and creates the executed-position birth at fill server time using fill value_a/value_b plus the matched placement stop/planned risk. Direction inferred from actual fill versus stop must equal the placement direction.
corrected_implementation_contract.passive_expire: PASSIVE_EXPIRE must match and clear the single pending record without creating a lifecycle, exposure or occupancy.
corrected_implementation_contract.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE continues to match the single active executed position for every component.
corrected_implementation_contract.period_integrity: Every period must end with zero active positions and zero Passive pending orders; exact Passive topology must remain 707/594/113.
